column1: # Paldeck (Zukan) numbers, keyed by internal CharacterID.
# the pak ships with `PKG_UnversionedProperties` set, so numeric DataTable
# fields cannot be deserialized without a `.usmap` schema that does not exist
# for this build. Names, localized text, and textures are schema-free and ARE
# read from the user's own pak (see `reference.rs`); dex numbers are the one
# Paldeck-facing field that isn't. The implementation plan pre-agreed this
# fallback: reference numbers from an external dataset, everything else local.
# Confirmed non-recoverable from the pak before adding this file: no Zukan or
# Paldeck DataTable exists (`MainMenu/Paldex/` is UI widgets only), and the
# are alphabetically sorted, so row order carries no ordering signal.
# (a CUE4Parse extraction of the same DataTable). Retrieved 2026-08-06.
# Variant suffixes are derived: within one index, the id without an `_` variant
# segment is the base and the other takes `B`. That rule was validated against
# blaynem/paldex's older `DT_PalMonsterParameter.json` dump, which carries real
# `ZukanIndexSuffix` values — 137 overlapping rows, zero suffix mismatches.
# - All 288 ids resolve against the user's own pak; zero unknown ids.
# - The 34 pak species left unnumbered are all tower-boss pairs, Terraria-collab
#   raid content, or unused/dev entries (e.g. `VolcanoDragon_omit`) — no real
#   Paldeck species is missing a number.
# - Numbering independently cross-checked against paldb.cc by joining on the
#   pak's own English display names: 97 species compared, 97 agreed.
#   Note the game RENUMBERED its Paldeck after launch; launch-era dumps
#   (Foxparks 005, Sparkit 007) disagree and are stale. Do not "correct"
# Regenerate after a game update that adds Pals, then re-run
